units.source_en: “Ueda Mondonoshō...? Never in my life have I heard that name.
units.source_zh: “上田主水正……爷爷可从来不曾听过这名号。

units.source_en: Here I come!”
units.source_zh: 爷爷来也！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “上田主水正……爷爷可从来不曾听过这名号。爷爷来也！”

paragraphs.source_en: Trading insults even at such a moment was an old custom among warriors of the age of war.

units.source_en: Trading insults even at such a moment was an old custom among warriors of the age of war.
units.source_zh: 在这种时候仍恶语相向，便是乱世武士的旧习。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在这种时候仍恶语相向，便是乱世武士的旧习。

paragraphs.source_en: The two clashed with their spears, and Mondonoshō's weapon snapped in two. Both evidently found drawing their swords too troublesome, for they leapt from their horses, grappled barehanded, and rolled together upon the ground.

units.source_en: The two clashed with their spears, and Mondonoshō's weapon snapped in two.
units.source_zh: 二人手持长矛拼在一处，主水正的长矛折成了两段。

units.source_en: Both evidently found drawing their swords too troublesome, for they leapt from their horses, grappled barehanded, and rolled together upon the ground.
units.source_zh: 二人亦都觉得用刀太麻烦，遂跳下马来，赤手空拳地搏斗，在地上扭成一团。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二人手持长矛拼在一处，主水正的长矛折成了两段。二人亦都觉得用刀太麻烦，遂跳下马来，赤手空拳地搏斗，在地上扭成一团。

paragraphs.source_en: The two appeared remarkably carefree, but in truth they were not. As they rolled over and over on the ground, retainers from both sides crowded near, each fearful that his own master might come to harm.

units.source_en: The two appeared remarkably carefree, but in truth they were not.
units.source_zh: 二者心境看来颇为豁达，实则不然。

units.source_en: As they rolled over and over on the ground, retainers from both sides crowded near, each fearful that his own master might come to harm.

ja.t: のことがあってはならぬと

units.source_zh: 二人在地上翻来滚去的时候，双方的侍从都靠了过来，唯恐自家主人遭遇不测。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二者心境看来颇为豁达，实则不然。二人在地上翻来滚去的时候，双方的侍从都靠了过来，唯恐自家主人遭遇不测。

paragraphs.source_en: As Okabe fled for his life along the road by which he had come, the melee at Kashii continued, and two victory cries rang out in succession: “Kameda Ōsumi-no-kami has taken the head of Tannowa Rokurōbyōe Shigemasa!” “Yokozeki Shinzaburō has taken Sakata Shōjirō's head!” Yokozeki Shinzaburō was one of Ueda Mondonoshō's men.

units.source_en: As Okabe fled for his life along the road by which he had come, the melee at Kashii continued, and two victory cries rang out in succession: “Kameda Ōsumi-no-kami has taken the head of Tannowa Rokurōbyōe Shigemasa!”
units.source_zh: 冈部沿来路亡命撤退之时，樫井的混战仍在继续，接连传来两次胜利的呼喊：“龟田大隅守拿下淡轮六郎兵卫重政的首级！”

units.source_en: “Yokozeki Shinzaburō has taken Sakata Shōjirō's head!”
units.source_zh: “坂田正二郎首级被横关新三郎割得！”

units.source_en: Yokozeki Shinzaburō was one of Ueda Mondonoshō's men.
units.source_zh: 横关新三郎乃是上田主水正手下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 冈部沿来路亡命撤退之时，樫井的混战仍在继续，接连传来两次胜利的呼喊：“龟田大隅守拿下淡轮六郎兵卫重政的首级！”“坂田正二郎首级被横关新三郎割得！”横关新三郎乃是上田主水正手下。

paragraphs.source_en: The clouds had now dispersed completely, and the sun beat mercilessly upon the earth. The rain-soaked road had dried, and the wind from the sea swept up dust from the ground, at times enveloping the fighting men. Ahead, the sea met the rain-washed blue sky in one unbroken expanse, but no one had the heart to admire the beauty.

units.source_en: The clouds had now dispersed completely, and the sun beat mercilessly upon the earth.
units.source_zh: 云已经完全散去，太阳毒辣辣地照射着大地。

units.source_en: The rain-soaked road had dried, and the wind from the sea swept up dust from the ground, at times enveloping the fighting men.
units.source_zh: 雨后的路面已干，海边吹来的风卷起地上的尘埃，时而罩住正在格斗的人们。

units.source_en: Ahead, the sea met the rain-washed blue sky in one unbroken expanse, but no one had the heart to admire the beauty.
units.source_zh: 前面的大海与雨后的碧空相接，天海一色，但是谁也无心欣赏美景。

paragraphs.source_zh: 云已经完全散去，太阳毒辣辣地照射着大地。雨后的路面已干，海边吹来的风卷起地上的尘埃，时而罩住正在格斗的人们。前面的大海与雨后的碧空相接，天海一色，但是谁也无心欣赏美景。

paragraphs.source_en: From horseback, Ban Dan'emon kept glancing back toward Kashii. At that moment, the warning of Tannowa Shigemasa, already slain by Kameda Ōsumi-no-kami, flashed through his mind. A messenger had already been sent; Lord Harufusa ought to arrive soon—he cast desperate glances all around, but saw only his own men trapped within the encirclement. The reinforcements were nowhere in sight. Could the relief force have fallen into an ambush as well? Enough—if so, his only choice was to withdraw for now.

units.source_en: From horseback, Ban Dan'emon kept glancing back toward Kashii.
units.source_zh: 塙团右卫门在马上不时回头往樫井方向张望。

units.source_en: At that moment, the warning of Tannowa Shigemasa, already slain by Kameda Ōsumi-no-kami, flashed through his mind.
units.source_zh: 此时此刻，已被龟田大隅守斩杀的淡轮重政的忠告掠过他的脑海。

units.source_en: A messenger had already been sent; Lord Harufusa ought to arrive soon—he cast desperate glances all around, but saw only his own men trapped within the encirclement. The reinforcements were nowhere in sight.
units.source_zh: 已经派人去报信了，治房大人应该快到了吧——他求救般地四处张望，看到的只是陷入重围的己方士众身影，增援的部队不见踪影。

units.source_en: Could the relief force have fallen into an ambush as well?
units.source_zh: 难道援军也中了埋伏？

units.source_en: Enough—if so, his only choice was to withdraw for now.

ja.t: ええい、そうであるなら、ひとまず

units.source_zh: 罢罢，要是如此，只有先行撤退了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 塙团右卫门在马上不时回头往樫井方向张望。此时此刻，已被龟田大隅守斩杀的淡轮重政的忠告掠过他的脑海。已经派人去报信了，治房大人应该快到了吧——他求救般地四处张望，看到的只是陷入重围的己方士众身影，增援的部队不见踪影。难道援军也中了埋伏？罢罢，要是如此，只有先行撤退了。

paragraphs.source_en: Most of his men had already fallen, and fewer than twenty remained. Ban Dan'emon gritted his teeth and was about to wheel his horse around in retreat. At that instant came a sharp hiss as an arrow tore through the air.

units.source_en: Most of his men had already fallen, and fewer than twenty remained.
units.source_zh: 手下士众大部都已倒下，剩下的不到二十人。

units.source_en: Ban Dan'emon gritted his teeth and was about to wheel his horse around in retreat.
units.source_zh: 塙团右卫门咬咬牙，就要调转马头往回撤。

units.source_en: At that instant came a sharp hiss as an arrow tore through the air.
units.source_zh: 此时，只听“嗖”的一声，一支箭破空而来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 手下士众大部都已倒下，剩下的不到二十人。塙团右卫门咬咬牙，就要调转马头往回撤。此时，只听“嗖”的一声，一支箭破空而来。

paragraphs.source_en: The archer was Tago Sukezaemon, an Asano warrior famed for his matchless skill with the bow.

units.source_en: The archer was Tago Sukezaemon, an Asano warrior famed for his matchless skill with the bow.
units.source_zh: 出手之人，乃是被称为神箭手的浅野武士多胡助左卫门。

paragraphs.source_zh: 出手之人，乃是被称为神箭手的浅野武士多胡助左卫门。

paragraphs.source_en: Struck in the thigh by an arrow from a powerful bow, Dan'emon fell from his horse yet leapt into the saddle again—a display of extraordinary valor. Seeing that the defenses were thin toward the coast, he drove his horse toward the sea.

units.source_en: Struck in the thigh by an arrow from a powerful bow, Dan'emon fell from his horse yet leapt into the saddle again—a display of extraordinary valor.
units.source_zh: 大腿被强弓射伤，落马之后却又再次跃马，团右卫门可谓勇猛异常。

units.source_en: Seeing that the defenses were thin toward the coast, he drove his horse toward the sea.
units.source_zh: 他见海岸方向守卫薄弱，遂驱马朝海边奔去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大腿被强弓射伤，落马之后却又再次跃马，团右卫门可谓勇猛异常。他见海岸方向守卫薄弱，遂驱马朝海边奔去。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ban Dan'emon! Taste the blade of Kameda Ōsumi!”

units.source_en: “Ban Dan'emon! Taste the blade of Kameda Ōsumi!”
units.source_zh: “塙团右卫门，吃你爷爷龟田大隅一刀！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “塙团右卫门，吃你爷爷龟田大隅一刀！”

paragraphs.source_en: Yet as he retreated toward Kashii, Ban Dan'emon encountered another and still more troublesome opponent. There seemed to be no way out.

units.source_en: Yet as he retreated toward Kashii, Ban Dan'emon encountered another and still more troublesome opponent. There seemed to be no way out.
units.source_zh: 然而，往樫井撤退的时候， 塙团右卫门碰上了另一个更难应付的对手，看来无路可走了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而，往樫井撤退的时候， 塙团右卫门碰上了另一个更难应付的对手，看来无路可走了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ho there! Is that not Ban Dan'emon, commander of the vanguard? I, Ueda Mondonoshō, have long been waiting for you. Let us fight to the death, man to man!”

units.source_en: “Ho there!
Is that not Ban Dan'emon, commander of the vanguard?
units.source_zh: 这不是先锋大将塙团右卫门吗？

units.source_en: I, Ueda Mondonoshō, have long been waiting for you.
units.source_zh: 爷爷上田主水正等你多时了。

units.source_en: Let us fight to the death, man to man!”
units.source_zh: 你我单枪匹马决一死战！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “呔！这不是先锋大将塙团右卫门吗？爷爷上田主水正等你多时了。你我单枪匹马决一死战！”

paragraphs.source_en: This was the exceedingly rough-tempered Ueda Mondonoshō, who had just killed one of Dan'emon's men in a barehanded struggle. At the Battle of Sekigahara he had been a retainer of Ishida Mitsunari; now he served Asano Nagaakira. Like Ban Dan'emon, he was one of the master-choosers so common in the age of war.

units.source_en: This was the exceedingly rough-tempered Ueda Mondonoshō, who had just killed one of Dan'emon's men in a barehanded struggle.
units.source_zh: 此人是性情甚是粗鲁的上田主水正，方才赤膊杀掉了团右卫门手下。

units.source_en: At the Battle of Sekigahara he had been a retainer of Ishida Mitsunari; now he served Asano Nagaakira.
units.source_zh: 他在关原合战时乃是石田三成家臣，现效命于浅野长晟。

units.source_en: Like Ban Dan'emon, he was one of the master-choosers so common in the age of war.
units.source_zh: 他与塙团右卫门一样，乃是乱世中常见的“择主”之人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此人是性情甚是粗鲁的上田主水正，方才赤膊杀掉了团右卫门手下。他在关原合战时乃是石田三成家臣，现效命于浅野长晟。他与塙团右卫门一样，乃是乱世中常见的“择主”之人。

paragraphs.source_en: Had it been anyone else, Ban Dan'emon might have evaded him and ridden on, but with Ueda Mondonoshō before him, he simply could not flee. If he fled now, the man would surely heap abuse upon him and mock him without mercy. Ban Dan'emon had no choice but to rein in his horse.

units.source_en: Had it been anyone else, Ban Dan'emon might have evaded him and ridden on, but with Ueda Mondonoshō before him, he simply could not flee.

ja.t: げたかもしれない。だが、
げるわけにはいかなかった。

units.source_zh: 要是别人， 塙团右卫门也许会退避而去，但现在他面前乃是上田主水正，他实无法逃遁。

units.source_en: If he fled now, the man would surely heap abuse upon him and mock him without mercy.
units.source_zh: 就此逃去，对方必然会施以恶骂，百般嘲笑。

units.source_en: Ban Dan'emon had no choice but to rein in his horse.
units.source_zh: 塙团右卫门不得已，只好停下马。

paragraphs.source_zh: 要是别人， 塙团右卫门也许会退避而去，但现在他面前乃是上田主水正，他实无法逃遁。就此逃去，对方必然会施以恶骂，百般嘲笑。塙团右卫门不得已，只好停下马。

paragraphs.source_en: “Well, if it is not Ueda Mondonoshō, the man who was beaten half to death at Sekigahara.”

units.source_en: “Well, if it is not Ueda Mondonoshō, the man who was beaten half to death at Sekigahara.”
units.source_zh: “嘿，原来是在关原合战中被打了个半死的上田主水正。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “嘿，原来是在关原合战中被打了个半死的上田主水正。”

paragraphs.source_en: “The very same. Afterward I shaved my head and became a monk for a time, taking the name Sōkichi Nyūdō. But when I heard the enemy had a man called Dan'emon, I returned to secular life and became Mondonoshō once more! Do not run!”

units.source_en: “The very same.
units.source_zh: “正是。

units.source_en: Afterward I shaved my head and became a monk for a time, taking the name Sōkichi Nyūdō.
units.source_zh: 那之后一度落发为僧，改名宗吉入道。

units.source_en: But when I heard the enemy had a man called Dan'emon, I returned to secular life and became Mondonoshō once more!
units.source_zh: 听说敌方有个团右卫门，我便还俗为先前的主水正了！

units.source_en: Do not run!”
units.source_zh: 休要逃！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正是。那之后一度落发为僧，改名宗吉入道。听说敌方有个团右卫门，我便还俗为先前的主水正了！休要逃！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Silence, you accursed villain! I had no wish to take your life, but I will grant you a contest. Weapons are too much bother. Let us settle it with our bare hands!”

units.source_en: “Silence, you accursed villain!
units.source_zh: “住嘴，该死的恶贼！

units.source_en: I had no wish to take your life, but I will grant you a contest.
units.source_zh: 本不想取尔性命，且跟尔比试比试。

units.source_en: Weapons are too much bother. Let us settle it with our bare hands!”
units.source_zh: 武刀太麻烦，我们赤手空拳较量！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “住嘴，该死的恶贼！本不想取尔性命，且跟尔比试比试。武刀太麻烦，我们赤手空拳较量！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good! Do you think I fear you?”

units.source_en: “Good!
Do you think I fear you?”
units.source_zh: 怕你不成！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好！怕你不成！”

paragraphs.source_en: By then not only muskets but even cannon were commonplace on the battlefield, yet these two delighted in fighting barehanded.

units.source_en: By then not only muskets but even cannon were commonplace on the battlefield, yet these two delighted in fighting barehanded.
units.source_zh: 如今别说火枪，就是大炮在战场上也司空见惯，二人却喜赤手空拳相搏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如今别说火枪，就是大炮在战场上也司空见惯，二人却喜赤手空拳相搏。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah, Mondonoshō is in danger! Save Mondonoshō!” Four or five Asano warriors came racing over and thrust their spears at Dan'emon.

units.source_en: “Ah, Mondonoshō is in danger! Save Mondonoshō!”
units.source_zh: “啊，主水正危险，快救主水正！”

units.source_en: Four or five Asano warriors came racing over and thrust their spears at Dan'emon.
units.source_zh: 浅野部的四五个武士飞奔过来，持着长矛朝团右卫门刺去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，主水正危险，快救主水正！”浅野部的四五个武士飞奔过来，持着长矛朝团右卫门刺去。

paragraphs.source_en: Ban Dan'emon twisted his left hand around Mondonoshō's neck and rose to his feet, while his right hand drew his sword. “Would the common rabble join in as well?” Gripping Mondonoshō with all his strength, he moved toward Kashii, brandishing his great sword all the while to keep the man's followers at bay.

units.source_en: Ban Dan'emon twisted his left hand around Mondonoshō's neck and rose to his feet, while his right hand drew his sword.
units.source_zh: 塙团右卫门用左手拧住主水正颈脖，站了起来，右手已拔出武刀。

units.source_en: “Would the common rabble join in as well?”
units.source_zh: “小卒子也要一起来？”

units.source_en: Gripping Mondonoshō with all his strength, he moved toward Kashii, brandishing his great sword all the while to keep the man's followers at bay.
units.source_zh: 他死劲抓着主水正，一边挥舞着大刀，防止对方手下靠近，一边朝樫井而去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 塙团右卫门用左手拧住主水正颈脖，站了起来，右手已拔出武刀。“小卒子也要一起来？”他死劲抓着主水正，一边挥舞着大刀，防止对方手下靠近，一边朝樫井而去。

paragraphs.source_en: “You are not getting away!” Mondonoshō's young retainer Yokozeki Shinzaburō came racing toward him.

units.source_en: “You are not getting away!”
units.source_zh: “哪里走！”

units.source_en: Mondonoshō's young retainer Yokozeki Shinzaburō came racing toward him.
units.source_zh: 主水正的年轻随从横关新三郎朝他急奔而来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哪里走！”主水正的年轻随从横关新三郎朝他急奔而来。

paragraphs.source_en: But after only seven or eight paces, Dan'emon's plan came to nothing. Young Yokozeki Shinzaburō saw that the wounded left leg could not support him, sprang forward in a single bound, and wrestled him to the ground.

units.source_en: But after only seven or eight paces, Dan'emon's plan came to nothing.
units.source_zh: 但刚刚走出七八步远，团右卫门的算盘就落空了。

units.source_en: Young Yokozeki Shinzaburō saw that the wounded left leg could not support him, sprang forward in a single bound, and wrestled him to the ground.
units.source_zh: 年轻的横关新三郎看到他受伤的左腿站立不稳，一个箭步冲上去，把他扳倒在地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但刚刚走出七八步远，团右卫门的算盘就落空了。年轻的横关新三郎看到他受伤的左腿站立不稳，一个箭步冲上去，把他扳倒在地。
